data.body_html:
Spend a sun-soaked day on the Costa del Sol with a marbella family boat day jetski snorkel paddleboard combo 2034 – a private charter that combines luxury, adventure, and quality time together. Departing from Puerto Banús, you'll cruise the Mediterranean in a premium motor yacht, with a free jetski (on select boats), snorkel gear, and a paddleboard included. No queues, no crowds – just your family, the sea, and a dedicated skipper. Prices start at €749 for a 4-hour charter on an Astondoa 40 or Azimut 39, with all drinks, snacks, fuel, and taxes covered.

Why choose this family boat day combo?

This isn't a standard boat trip. It's a curated experience designed for families who want to do more than just sit on deck. You get the freedom to explore the coastline, jump into crystal-clear coves, and try watersports – all without hidden costs. The package includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). Snorkel masks, fins, and a paddleboard are provided at no extra charge. On the Mangusta 80, a jetski is also included free for the duration of the charter.

Which boat is best for your family?

We have three main options for this combo, all departing from Puerto Banús:

  • Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 passengers) – €749 for 4 hours. Perfect for smaller families. Includes paddleboard and snorkel gear.
  • Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 passengers) – €749 for 4 hours. More space for a larger family group. Same inclusions.
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 passengers) – €4,719 minimum 4 hours. Comes with a free jetski. Ideal if you want the jetski experience for older kids and adults.

All boats are well-maintained, comfortable, and equipped with sun pads, a shaded area, and a sound system. For bigger families or those wanting a jetski, the Mangusta 80 is the clear winner – though at a higher price point.

What to expect on the day

Your charter begins at your chosen time from Puerto Banús. The skipper will give a safety briefing, then you'll cruise west or east depending on wind and swell. Popular spots include the calm waters off Cabopino, the secluded Cala del Faro, and the scenic Cala Cortés. Once anchored, you can swim, snorkel among the rocks, paddleboard along the shore, or (on the Mangusta 80) take the jetski for a spin. The skipper will handle everything – just relax and enjoy. The return journey includes a slow cruise back past the Marbella skyline and the Golden Mile.

Pricing and booking details

Prices are transparent and all-inclusive. No surprise charges at the end. For the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39, the 4-hour rate is €749. For the Mangusta 80 (white or grey), the minimum charter is 4 hours at €4,719 – this includes the jetski. All other boats in our fleet (e.g., the Ferretti 94, Pershing 46, or Lagoon 380) are available on request; pricing is via WhatsApp. We recommend booking at least 48 hours in advance, especially during peak summer months (June–September).

What's included in every charter

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the full duration
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks (e.g., crisps, nuts, olives)
  • Snorkel masks, fins, and paddleboard
  • Jetski (only on Mangusta 80 charters)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • 21% Spanish IVA (VAT)

Tips for a perfect family boat day

  • Bring sunscreen, hats, and sunglasses – the Mediterranean sun is strong even in spring.
  • Pack towels, swimwear, and a change of clothes.
  • If you want a specific lunch, bring your own food; the skipper can recommend a spot to stop for a swim.
  • For younger children, life jackets are available on board (please request sizes in advance).
  • Arrive 15 minutes early at Puerto Banús to find parking and meet the crew.
